subject: Cross-functional promo top-up & vesting clarity — Anika Shah
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-functional promo top-up & vesting clarity — Anika Shah

Team —

I want to request an exceptioned compensation package and a one-time equity refresh for Anika Shah (anika.shah@example.com). She’s the senior ML engineer on the Relevance squad who we promoted to Principal on an accelerated timeline (org needs + cross-functional scope) and we’re seeing immediate retention risk (has a competing offer with higher cash & RSU).

Proposal summary (requesting HR/people approval + AD sign-off):
- Base: no change (current $180k)
- One-time discretionary cash retention: $12,000 gross (payable in November)
- Merit/top-up: 10% spot increase effective 10/15 (exception to standard timing)
- Equity refresh: 12-month cliffed grant of 0.30% in RSUs (4-year schedule, prorated first-year vesting 25% on first anniversary)
- Vesting clarity: ask Legal/Equity (cc Carta) to confirm that refresh can be structured as RSU grant and not recharge old grants.

Rationale:
- Critical cross-functional ownership across infra + search; loss would create a 2–3 month product hit and re-hire risk.
- Market comp analysis (below) shows people at similar scope/geo getting ~0.4–0.6% refresh with higher cash; we’re offering a balanced package to keep internal equity intact.

I’ve attached a short export (promo_summary_anika.csv) with Anika’s current comp, manager note, and benchmarking links. I’m asking for an expedited review (48–72h) if possible. Approvals needed: People (Marissa), People Lead (Laura), and Finance sign-off from Aditya (cc’d) for one-time cash & budget.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa: review and confirm whether this is allowable under policy and any required approvals.
2) Legal/Equity (Mina): confirm structuring + Carta entry.
3) Aditya: confirm budget availability for one-time cash.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive given candidate counter-offer timing. Happy to jump on a quick 15m if that helps.

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Manager, Relevance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-10-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-functional promo top-up & vesting clarity — Anika Shah

Dylan —

Thanks for the write-up and for flagging urgency. I reviewed the attached CSV quickly — helpful. I’ll run a formal market check and align against current band guardrails. Quick notes:
- One-time cash of $12k is within what we’ve approved historically for similar retention cases, but Finance/Aditya needs to confirm budget pool availability.
- Equity refresh of 0.30% is slightly above what we typically do for internal promotions at this level; I’ll need an explicit rationale and impact to band parity.

I’ve attached the Q3 comp bands analysis I pulled (market_comp_bands_q3_analysis.pdf) that shows local market medians for Principal/Staff ML roles. That should help frame the ask to Finance.

Action items for me:
1) I’ll get a formal recommendation (approve/approve-with-conditions/decline) by EOD tomorrow.
2) If approved, we’ll draft an amended offer (Marissa → Anika) and run DocuSign.
3) Mina, can you confirm Carta workflow for a top-up RSU and whether we need a separate grant type?

One more ask: please include the manager note that captures impact + risk (I’ll need a concise 2–3 line justification to include in the approval packet).

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. People Partner, Compensation & Rewards
Redwood Inference
Attachment: market_comp_bands_q3_analysis.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Cross-functional promo top-up & vesting clarity — Anika Shah

Marissa — thanks. Attached is a short manager note and the export with comp breakdown (promo_summary_anika.csv). Copy below for convenience:

Manager justification (to include in approval packet):
Anika owns relevance ranking across search + feed, recently absorbed ownership for the feature rollout that crosses infra, search, and product. She coordinated three teams to hit the Q3 launch; losing her now would delay roadmap items and push two hires (6–9 weeks) while impacting customer metrics. Counter-offer includes higher base + 0.5% RSU. This package balances internal parity while addressing near-term retention risk.

I can be on standby for any clarifying q’s.

—
Dylan

Subject: Re: Cross-functional promo top-up & vesting clarity — Anika Shah

Thanks for the clear packet. I support an expedited review but want to preserve precedents for the org. Quick guidance:

- I’m comfortable with the one-time cash and the 10% merit top-up given the cross-functional impact, but the equity refresh should be treated conservatively. Recommend 0.25% instead of 0.30% unless Finance/Comp agrees to the higher figure.
- Please confirm that granting 0.25% won’t create band compression vs other Principal hires in the same ladder — Marissa, can you run a quick parity check?
- Aditya — if cash is approved, can you confirm charge code and whether it needs CFO pre-approval?

If we get parity confirmation and Finance sign-off, proceed with amended offer and Carta entry. Approve conditionally pending paperwork.

Laura
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-10-05T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Final — Conditional approval and next steps (Anika Shah)

Team —

Quick update after running parity and confirming budget with Aditya: finance confirms one-time cash is available from the Q4 retention pool (Aditya has approved charge code: FIN-Q4-RET-22). Parity check: 0.25% keeps Anika within the 75th percentile vs recent Principal hires; 0.30% would create >2 decile delta versus cohort. Given Laura’s guidance, Marissa recommends moving forward with the following:

Approved (conditional):
- One-time cash: $12,000 gross (payable Nov payroll).
- Merit/top-up: 10% effective 10/15.
- Equity refresh: 0.25% RSU (4-year standard schedule, prorated first-year vesting).

Conditions:
1) Manager to include the concise justification (Dylan’s manager note) in the offer packet.
2) Legal/Equity (Mina) to confirm Carta grant type & coordinate issuance (cc: carta-admin@carta.com).
3) Offer letter/amended terms to be executed via DocuSign; I’ve drafted the document and attached amended_offer_anika.docx and prepared the DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/0f3e5c2a

If no objections by EOD tomorrow I’ll instruct People Ops to send the DocuSign packet and raise payroll ticket for the one-time cash. Dylan — please confirm you’ll send the manager note into the packet and confirm Anika’s preferred contact email (do we use her personal or current Redwood email?).

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. People Partner, Compensation & Rewards
Redwood Inference
